subject: Conditional discount triggers, PO memo fields, and ERP SKU alignment
messages:
-----Message 1-----
From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@aurorahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discount structure questions / PO memo fields

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement had a couple of follow-ups before we loop legal:

1) We have an internal policy that discounts over 15% require a conditional-credit trigger on the PO (we put a clause that allows a temporary credit hold if SLA targets are missed). Can Redwood accept inclusion of that wording in our PO? If yes, we need the exact language you prefer.

2) Our ERP requires a specific memo field to map subscription SKUs to our chart of accounts: "GL_CODE|PROJECT_ID|PO_LINE". Can you confirm what values Redwood needs for GL mapping? We can populate them on our side but want to avoid rework.

3) Invoice cadence: we prefer monthly invoices but some of our finance team wants the option to do a quarterly consolidated invoice for any tranche < $10k. Is that something Redwood can support? If not, what alternatives?

Attached is our standard PO template (Aurora_PO_Template.pdf) with the section highlighted.

Appreciate a quick run-through so we can move to legal.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dawson
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Aurora Health Systems
[attachment: Aurora_PO_Template.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

-----Message 2-----
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discount structure questions / PO memo fields

Hi Claire — great to hear from you. Short answers up front, then a recommended approach.

1) Conditional credit hold clause: Redwood is open to a narrowly scoped clause that triggers a temporary credit hold if we miss a monthly SLA (p99 latency or error-rate thresholds) for two consecutive billing periods. We prefer the trigger to be objective (metrics/reporting) and limited in duration (max one billing cycle). Suggested language below.

2) ERP memo field: We can accept a single pipe-delimited memo in the PO. For mapping, Redwood needs: SKU, billing metric (e.g., "tokens" or "seats"), and the Redwood invoice code. Example: "RW-SKU-LLM1|tokens|INV-2026-01". If you provide GL_CODE and PROJECT_ID, we will echo them back on the invoice.

3) Invoice cadence: We support monthly invoices by default. Quarterly consolidated invoices for tranches under $10k are possible but require a billing flag on the PO ("consolidate_quarterly=true") and a signed amendment for payment timing. Finance would like to approve on a per-account basis.

Suggested clause for your PO (placeholder values in brackets):
"If Redwood Inference fails to meet the agreed SLA for p99 latency or error rate for two consecutive billing periods as measured in Redwood's Console and API metrics, Aurora may place a temporary credit hold on future invoices for a single billing cycle. Prior to any credit hold, Aurora will provide Redwood with 10 business days' written notice and Redwood will have an opportunity to remediate. Credits applied will be limited to amounts attributable to the affected billing period."

I'll loop in Marissa (revenue ops) and Evelyn (finance) to confirm the net terms and any limits on discounts or hold mechanics.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[sent from mobile]

-----Message 3 (internal)-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discount structure questions / PO memo fields

Quick notes:
- Finance (Evelyn) prefers we cap cumulative contractual discounts that allow credit holds. If Aurora wants >15% off, we should convert the incremental into a pre-paid/commit structure or a time-limited promotional credit, not an open credit line.
- For the credit-hold trigger, ops needs to own the remediation SLA (we can't have open-ended rights). Priyom's language looks fine so long as "remediate" is defined (e.g., corrective patch or failover demo).
- Quarterly consolidated invoice: acceptable only if they sign the amendment and we add a 1.5% administrative processing fee to cover reconciliation.

If Priyom is comfortable pushing the language, Marissa suggests proposing (a) a max 6-month promotional discount ladder for anything >15% with clear renewal pricing, or (b) a prepay discount that avoids credit-hold mechanics.

Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations

-----Message 4-----
From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@aurorahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discount structure questions / PO memo fields

Thanks — that all makes sense. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- We can accept the remediation window (10 business days) but need to preserve the right to escalate to a controller-level review if unresolved after the hold period. That would be a governance step on our end, not an extension of the hold.
- Aurora is open to a short-term promotional ladder for early-commit discounts. Can Redwood provide an example ladder (e.g., 10% at $100k ARR, 20% at $250k ARR, etc.)? We prefer milestones tied to committed spend, not just usage.
- For ERP mapping: we'll populate GL_CODE and PROJECT_ID. Please confirm you'll echo them on the invoice PDF.

Attached is our slightly edited PO template with the memo example filled in.

Claire

-----Message 5 (final internal / outbound)-----
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Conditional discount triggers, PO memo fields, and ERP SKU alignment

Claire — thanks for the edits and for filling in the memo. We're aligned on the approach. Next steps and commitments: 

1) Redwood will accept the conditional credit-hold clause with the following guardrails: credit hold limited to one billing cycle; 10 business days' notice; Redwood remediation scope limited to operational fixes listed in the SOW. Legal will add precise remediation examples.

2) Invoice/ERP mapping: Redwood will echo GL_CODE and PROJECT_ID in the invoice PDF under line-item notes. Please include them in PO line 1 when you submit.

3) Discount ladder: attached is a short example ladder (inline here for convenience):
   - $100k committed ARR -> 10% discount (12-month term)
   - $250k committed ARR -> 18% discount (12-month term)
   - $500k committed ARR -> 25% discount (prepay option or 12-month term)

4) Quarterly consolidated invoice: allowed with flag on PO (consolidate_quarterly=true) and the 1.5% processing fee applied. Finance (Evelyn) has prelim ok but will confirm once PO submitted.

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v3.docx (we'll update remediation examples) and a redlined PO example. If everything looks good on your side, please send the completed PO back to procurement@redwoodhealth.com and copy legal@redwood.ai so we can finalize.

Thanks — we'll have legal and finance follow up as needed.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
